{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-run the stratified analysis with explicit weighting to avoid nan
# Compute the weighted average of treatment effects across severity strata

total_n = len(df)
stratum_counts = df['severity'].value_counts()
stratum_weights = stratum_counts / total_n

# Compute weighted treatment effect
weighted_effect = 0.0
for severity, group in df.groupby('severity'):
    control_rate = group[group['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
    treatment_rate = group[group['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
    effect = treatment_rate - control_rate
    weight = stratum_weights[severity]
    weighted_effect += effect * weight

# Final outputs
